primaryObject: PM-Bench: Evaluating Prospective Memory in LLM Agents
researchQuestion: What runtime architecture is required when an agent must execute the latest valid deferred intention at the correct future cue rather than merely recall it?
coreProposition: Deferred intentions should be versioned runtime objects with explicit observation, due-state admission and effect evidence, not plain memory entries.
evidenceBoundary: Paper plus author-maintained repository are primary/first-party evidence; source-reported numbers were not independently reproduced; the four-boundary runtime model is Research Center synthesis.
title_en: A Deferred Intention Is Not a Memory Entry
title_zh: 延迟意图不是一条记忆
